name: Family Apart
beschreibung:
Located in the family-friendly village of Fulpmes in the Stubai valley, Family Apart provides ample space for a carefree holiday. The well-appointed apartments feature modern kitchens, comfortable living areas, and sunny balconies.

The nearby Schlick 2000 ski area, adventure hiking paths, and the StuBay waterpark ensure diverse entertainment for all generations.
kurzbeschreibung: Family Apart in Fulpmes in the Stubaital offers generous holiday apartments designed for families close to Schlick 2000.
